# Shree Kshetrapal Jain Atithi Bhavan, Mumbai

> Official, peaceful, and hygienic Jain Dharamshala and pilgrim guest house located in Thakurdwar / Chira Bazar, South Mumbai.

- **Canonical Website**: https://www.kshetrapaljainatithibhavan.co.in/
- **Address**: 1, Zaobawadi, Chira Bazar Road, near Ram Mandir, Thakurdwar, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400002, India
- **Coordinates**: 18.9482° N, 72.8258° E
- **Phone / Reception**: +91 9760933661
- **WhatsApp Reservations**: https://wa.me/919760933661
- **Standard Check-in / Check-out**: 11:00 AM Check-in / 10:00 AM Check-out (24-hour cycle arrangements upon request)

## Accommodation & Tariffs

All rates are per night, transparent, and direct without middleman commissions:
- **Dormitory – Bed**: ₹800 / night (Budget individual pilgrim accommodation)
- **AC Hall – Bed**: ₹800 / night (Air-cooled spacious shared hall for groups)
- **Non-AC Room**: ₹1,800 / night (Clean, ventilated private room with attached bathroom)
- **Super Deluxe Room**: ₹2,400 / night (Spacious family room)
- **Super Delux Room (AC)**: ₹2,800 / night (Premium air-conditioned private room)
- **6 Beds AC Room**: ₹3,850 / night (Large family suite and yatri sangh room)

## Key Amenities & Satvik Discipline

- Strictly pure satvik atmosphere adhering to Jain principles (Ahimsa, purity, peace).
- 24/7 running hot water in all attached bathrooms.
- Pure filtered drinking water available 24 hours.
- High-security 24/7 CCTV surveillance throughout common areas.
- Elevator / lift access to all floors; senior-citizen and wheelchair friendly.
- Safe luggage storage before check-in or after check-out for train travelers.
- Multiple authentic Jain Bhojanalays serving pure satvik meals before chauvihar (sunset) within 200m walking distance.

## Transit & Landmark Proximity

- **Marine Lines Railway Station (Western Local)**: ~800 meters (10 min walk)
- **Charni Road Railway Station (Western Local)**: ~1.1 km (15 min walk)
- **CSMT Terminal (Central & Outstation Trains)**: ~2.2 km (8–10 min taxi)
- **Mumbai Central Station (Western Outstation Trains)**: ~3.5 km (12–15 min taxi)
- **Shri Godiji Parshwanath Jain Derasar (Pydhonie)**: ~1.8 km
- **Babu Amichand Panalal Adishwarji Jain Temple (Walkeshwar)**: ~3.8 km
- **Local Swetambar & Digambar Derasars (Chira Bazar / Thakurdwar)**: 200 to 500 meters
